name: DENC11SNOMEDConceptMap
title: DEN.C11 ConceptMap to SNOMED CT
description: Candidate mappings from DEN.C11 local concepts to SNOMED CT, transcribed from the source data dictionary without asserting exact equivalence.

text.div: SNOMED CT candidates and displays are transcribed from the workbook. The same broad hematocrit finding candidate is supplied for rising and falling; the first evaluation has no SNOMED candidate for normal hematocrit. Mappings use relatedto and require terminology review.
